title: The sections kb-item reads leave room under their byte bound: reference lists move under headings of their own
goal: The kb-item skill's reading command (selfdoc.py section over backlog.md's The item file, Dependencies gates and triggers, Definition of done, Working on items and Git, and maintaining.md's Conduct for changes) prints at most 27000 bytes, 3000 under test_kb_item_reading's READING_BOUND of 30000 (it printed about 29997 after ST-ikh2h7m5): reference lists a worker does not need on every item (the repro own-error list, the land step list, the drift and intake rules) move under headings of their own in backlog.md, which the sections link to, and nothing they say is lost; test_kb_item_reading_bound passes with the margin asserted.
